name: Ch.5 · A Path Through the Water

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Pharaoh changed his mind. Six hundred of his best chariots pursued the Israelites to the edge of the sea.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Trapped. Water before them. Army behind them. No way forward.

lines.speaker: israelite_elder
lines.text: Was it because there were no graves in Egypt that you brought us out here to die?!

lines.speaker: moses
lines.text: Do not be afraid. Stand firm and you will see the deliverance the LORD will bring you today.

lines.speaker: god
lines.text: Lift up your staff and stretch out your hand over the sea to divide it.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: All that night a strong east wind drove the sea back. The water divided. The seabed was dry ground.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Moses stretched out his hand. The people walked through on dry ground, with walls of water on their right and on their left.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The Egyptians followed — every horse and chariot, every driver — into the middle of the sea.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: At daybreak, the LORD looked down from the pillar of fire and cloud and threw the Egyptian army into confusion.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Moses stretched out his hand over the sea. The waters rushed back and covered the chariots and horsemen.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Not one of them survived. Israel saw the great power the LORD displayed against the Egyptians, and the people feared the LORD.
